    ## [How do I follow up with people who messaged but did not buy?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-follow-up-with-people-who-messaged-but-did-not-buy/)

    ## [What should my Black Friday auto-reply say?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-should-my-black-friday-auto-reply-say/)

    A good auto-reply answers the question the buyer asked, gives them the next step, and sounds like you. Skip the 'we will get back to you' message. Write short replies for the questions you get most, with your price, your delivery details and your checkout link.

    ## [How do I get my Instagram DMs ready for Black Friday?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-get-my-instagram-dms-ready-for-black-friday/)

    ## [What happens to my Black Friday ad spend if I reply too slowly?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-happens-to-my-black-friday-ad-spend-if-i-reply-too-slowly/)

    Your ads keep spending whether or not anyone answers. If a buyer messages and waits, you have paid for the click and lost the sale. Fix your reply speed first, so every message gets an answer in seconds, even when you are asleep, and only then raise your budget.
